notes.title: Major Update – SWAT Commander: Prologue, version 0.7.6.4
notes.content:
Officers,  

We continue gathering feedback and using it to find ways to improve the prologue for you. Our latest solutions bring you this patch.



AI

Fixed aiming for Suspects using the RPG launcher or the kamikaze behavior model

Civilians now react to nearby shooting when they have already surrendered

Updated Suspect/Civilian alert system

Improved the system of Suspects focusing on noise as well as fixed various character focus issues

Fixed issues with Suspects’ fake surrender mechanic working less reliably than intended

Improved the ability of suspects and civilians to position themselves away from a door when surrendering

Suspects won't shoot if their target is not properly within line of sight

Improved the grenade throwing system of the AI to make it more consistent



GAMEPLAY

Added bullet exit traces to surfaces they can penetrate

Updated Less Lethal Shotgun damage to be, in fact, less lethal

Updated noise system (it should now be easier to generate the necessary noise for various events at difficulty levels above Easy)

Updated C2 interaction area to make placing the charge easier and stop the lock and Tactical Mirror prompts from getting in the way

Fixed door ramming issues with the Battering Ram

Fixed issues related to carrying out and interrupting the restraining process

Fixed NPC head rotation bug

Fixed the ‘Bring Order to Chaos’ objective, so that it is properly checked off

Updated bleeding system

Sniper's shooting is now improved with better mechanics and noise generation

Fixed RPG missile damage

Sniper no longer reports previously reported individuals

Fixed penalties not being accounted correctly for characters with grenades

Fixed error caused by switching from leaning to sprinting in co-op



EQUIPMENT

Sight movement while Aiming Down Sights (ADS), affected by the Officer’s breathing, is significantly reduced

Increased speed of entering ADS

Reduced recoil for all handguns

Fixed character model collision issue for taking damage when the character is using the Ballistic Shield

Fixed Shotguns recoiling infinitely while firing

Fixed issues related to incorrect Pepper Spray functioning for characters with injured hands

Fixed 2x and 3x scopes lowering performance



ANIMATIONS

Updated Officers melee animations for special equipment

Improved scared state animations for Civilians and Suspects

Removed the ability of Suspects to reload while fake surrendering, which broke the process

Fixed an issue where the character would get stuck in the ground while incapacitated

Fixed pickup animations for characters interacting with a Battering Ram or Ballistic Shield equipped

Fixed issues related to Ballistic Shield collision models

Fixed issue related to NPCs performing ADS while having the Ballistic Shield equipped

Fixed various Injector interaction animations (e.g. interactions with other Officers, incapacitation movement bug)

Fixed player's interaction with the Door Wedge,

Surrendering will no longer interrupt scared-state animations of characters



NETWORK

Added a Character Selection tab in the Loadout screen, play as any one of the available Officers (it will only apply to co-op in Early Access, too)



USER INTERFACE

Added special Evidence locating hints that should make securing it far more efficient during a playthrough

Added equipment presets and equipment randomization button to the Loadout screen, which allows you to save and load specific equipment setups

Added equipment counters to grenades menu

Added ‘Back to Briefing’ and ‘Back to Main Menu’ confirmation screens

Added gamepad support for tutorial UI

Revamped the layout of the briefing and co-op screen for improved functionality

Gamepad keybind improvements with various menus and equipment for easier use

Updated hints with references to gamepad keybinds

Fixed gamepad-focus-related issues in the weapon customization screen

Fixed issue caused by carrying multiple Pepper Sprays



AUDIO

Added immersive new HQ background SFX to the main menu

Added new TOC dialogue for reporting Civilians, Evidence, and Suspects

Added immersive new radio signal to alert about downed Officers

Decreased Suspect/Civilian footstep volume

Added introductory narration to mission briefing

Added sound effects to broken light sources

Added additional sound effects to the "Hot Reception" map



VISUALS

Updated "Low" and "Medium" graphics quality presets to offer better performance

Fixed Smoke Grenade affecting game performance

Added door handle rotation when the doors are used by characters

Improved optimization for particles

notes.title: Recent News & Incoming Prologue Update
notes.content:
Officers,

We're proud to report that our current stats show our game's free co-op prologue has been activated on Steam over 300 000 times, matching our initial wishlist and then some! So, thank you again for trying out SWAT Commander: Prologue! 

Many of the game's improvements just wouldn't be possible without your involvement, so we appreciate every bit of feedback that we can use. And speaking of using your feedback, our team is of course still hard at work introducing further enhancements to our main app, due to be released in Early Access soon.

What's very relevant to the prologue, however, is that we're going to use our progress with the main game to do a solid new update of the prologue app as well. Stay tuned for news on that, too.

For more updates on both our progress and the EA release date, we invite you to follow the full SWAT Commander game here on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Weapon Update – SWAT Commander: Prologue, version 0.7.5.14
notes.content:
Officers,

We continue gathering feedback and using it to find ways to improve the prologue for you. Our latest solutions bring you this patch.

EQUIPMENT

Changed the position of all primary weapons relative to the player's camera to make the first-person perspective more convenient
Implemented new weapon movement animations for primary weapons to achieve a much smoother effect and better handling simulation

Over and out,

notes.title: Further Prologue Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
Officers, 

We continue our work on improving the prologue. All of it is based on the invaluable feedback with which you've been providing us and of course our drive to improve your experience with our preview of the game. So, today we're rolling out another update, this one for version 0.7.5.13, patch 0.4. 

Here's a brief reminder of the recent changes to the prologue:


Updated difficulty levels: the Easy level now provides conditions better suited for getting to know the game's mechanics while the other levels were adjusted to improve the gameplay experience
Updated Civilian behavior: Civilians are now more willing to comply with SWAT operatives' orders.
Adjusted FXAA anti-aliasing to improve its visual presentation.
Reconfigured the lobby system to focus on manually adding players via Steam friends list to improve the co-op experience.
Fixed a stability issue reported to occur when Officers are in combat and when Suspects deploy grenades against you.
Fixed the issue of grenade icons not appearing on screen for grenades thrown by Suspects.
Based on your reports, we've resolved a number of matters that could cause the game to become unstable. Your general experience with the prologue's stability should now be improved.
Version 0.7.5.13, patch 0.4 changes:


The Briefing screen has been revamped with more compacted sections for easier, more intuitive navigation. Many of our players have been, for example, skipping the option of selecting the entry point where you start the mission. We intend for this to make the Briefing features easier to access.
Fixed an issue that allowed the camera to clip through walls and doors.
Fixed an issue where some barricaded doors were in the wrong position for players who joined someone else's multiplayer lobby (clients).
We've reworked a number of the game's features. They are now not impacted so much by the players' internet connection during co-op gameplay, which should result in general performance improvements in the game.
👉 CRUCIAL NOTE: Please remember that the functioning of the multiplayer lobby depends on the host as well. Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your configuration meets the game's specs if you wish to host a game. 

Standby for further updates.

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Updates / Thank You for Joining the Prologue’s Launch
notes.content:
Officers, 

We're creating SWAT Commander for you and we stand with you as our community, so following our prologue's launch, we'd like to first thank you all for joining to give the game a shot. We're excited to see that you are playing SWAT Commander, and we would also appreciate any constructive feedback from you if we can use it to improve the game. We are a small team with big ambitions, and we would like to make sure to bring you a title you will enjoy. Without you, it is impossible. 

Following that, we realize our co-op prologue hasn't met many of your expectations and we want to do what we can to address your concerns and further enhance your experience with SWAT Commander.

To that end, we've already updated the prologue. Based on your recent gameplay experience, we would like to give you the solutions:

- We've resolved an issue that caused some language versions of the game to be unavailable
- We've disabled the Quick Match feature in favor of making public lobbies simpler. Go to 'Browse Lobby' and join from there for a game with random players.
- Your lobby's roster is now locked once everyone selects the 'Ready' status; it re-opens only after the mission is over
- The team bar now features a permanent 'leave lobby' button to make exiting one easier

👉 CRUCIAL NOTE: Please remember that the functioning of the multiplayer lobby depends on the host as well. Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your configuration meets the game's specs if you wish to host a game. 

Those are our updates for now. Much like in a SWAT intervention where something unexpected happens, you respond, you adapt, and then you persevere. We remain in the line of duty.

Over and NOT out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: SWAT Commander: Prologue Releases on April 4th!
notes.content:
Officers,

The time has finally come! We're proud to announce that SWAT Commander's free prologue is going to officially become available here on Steam on April 4th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/SWAT_Commander_Prologue/

As a reminder – SWAT Commander: Prologue is fully co-op, so grab a few friends to tackle the challenges of the "Hot Reception" mission! Take note: You 'can' start the game as a single player by readying up in the multiplayer lobby by yourself but this increases the difficulty considerably!

Enter the Bernard Tire & Auto Center to resolve the aftermath of a brutal gang shootout and bring the perpetrators of the resulting violence to justice.

The mission can be played in three different game modes, altering the mission's objectives. Study the operation's briefing, manage your officer's equipment loadout, and select either of two different entry points for the designated area to commence the intervention.

Check out our release trailer for the Prologue here:
[previewyoutube=Zzn_lFefEMI;full][/previewyoutube]

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: New Game – Laundering Simulator!
notes.content:
Introducing Laundering Simulator!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator/

Meet Eddie Wiser, the unlikely hero of our new project's story. Though he may not seem like it, Eddie's been handy with the hammer and wrench ever since he was just a wee troublemaker. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/368fec66ea6ee80457e06640a4905e709fcbcdd2.gif

Always tinkering with one machine or another and with an equal penchant for running into trouble with the law, he eventually grew up to be a sly entrepreneur. And his brilliant scheme of the day is to run a laundromat as a front for a whimsical forgery workshop hidden away in its back! 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/e266a322c10beef24dc30697e57f2ca36dfef3c8.gif

What led him to such a wild enterprise? Well, it'll be your job as the player to find out as you help Eddie run his daily activities:

 Serving the laundromat's customers
 Repairing machines
 Decorating your venue
 Ordering supplies
 Placing all the different items and managing space
 Handling laundromat finances
 Assembling various counterfeiting machines in the back
 Selling the different fakes to your friendly neighborhood fence
 Accepting special counterfeiting jobs
 Dealing with the local mob and authorities
 Taking care of an infuriating grandmother

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/13feb1c22441f26a42a7feb9cd8ada4af354f2ff.gif

Whew! Eddie's got his hands full, so he really needs your help! Check out Laundering Simulator's Steam page and add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Updates and Second Playtest!
notes.content:
Officers,

As we work on numerous aspects of SWAT Stories, its prologue version, "First Shot" receives several fixes and improvements. But we know there's a piece of news you've been waiting for even more eagerly. So, we're happy to confirm that our game's playtest returns tomorrow on Friday, November 24th at 3pm CET (9am EST) WITH A BRAND NEW MISSION – "HOT RECEPTION".

We'll make another announcement once the playtest is available to remind you about it. Remember, we'll be using the prologue's app for it right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/Tactical_Squad_SWAT_Stories__First_Shot/

Only when the playtest is live, will you be able to sign up (you won't need to sign up if you took part in the first playtest) and download/update the game.

Here are some updates you can expect in the second playtesting round:

GAMEPLAY

 New mission - Hot Reception
 Improved suspects' AI behavior models
 Improved operators' AI reactions
 Revised evidence mechanic model
 Added a possible spawn for an "exceptionally creative" suspect
 Added new interactive elements: gas tanks, rolling chairs, CCTV cameras, interactable doors on furniture
 Added the 'Ping' function - setting a marker at a certain place in a cooperative game

EQUIPMENT

 Improved grenade physics
 Improved optical sights
 Fixed Tablet issues in Chinese localization

BRIEFING

 updated Briefing screen
 Changed the logic of creating a lobby and switching the status between private and public lobby
 Added 'Quick Match' feature
 Added text chat for the team in the lobby
 Updated menu and weapon customization screen

TUTORIAL

 Fixed gameplay issues and localization errors in various languages

VISUAL

 Added glass damage effects on cars
 Added environmental response to weather changes
 Fixed visual issues with blood spawning
 Fixed a number of miscellaneous visual glitches

Add our game to your wishlist to support our project and join our Discord server to take part in the discussion of Tactical Squad and its features!

Over and out,
Red Mountain Games & Ritual Interactive
